journey.title: Tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown
journey.goal: After a keyboard user leaves the navigation, the Shop dropdown no longer covers the page

steps.title: Tab out of the navigation to search

functionalJourney.title: Open the Shop dropdown with the pointer

guards.title: Escape closes the Shop dropdown and returns focus to Shop
guards.goal: Escape inside the dropdown closes it

plan.root_cause: The disclosure menu lacks a focusout/blur handler to close submenus when keyboard focus leaves the menu via Tab, causing the Shop dropdown to remain open and cover page content.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout event listener to the root menu element that closes any open submenus when the related target is outside the menu, mirroring the existing pointerup outside-click behavior.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a user tabs out of the navigation bar, any open disclosure menu will close, preventing it from obscuring page content and restoring expected visibility of underlying elements.
functional_risks: Potential premature closure if focus temporarily leaves to a non-menu element that should keep the menu open (unlikely as focusout only fires when relatedTarget is outside).
May interfere with custom widgets that rely on focusout for other purposes.
Screen reader users might experience the menu closing automatically when exiting via Tab, which aligns with typical disclosure menu behavior.
verification_requirements: After the change, tabbing from the Shop button to the search input must result in aria-expanded="false" on the Shop button and the Plants link not being visible.
Keyboard opening of the Shop menu via Enter or Space must still work.
Navigation within the open menu using arrow keys, Home, End must remain functional.
Pressing Escape while the menu is open must close it and return focus to the Shop button.
Clicking outside the menu with the mouse must still close it.
Menu should not close when moving focus between items inside the menu (e.g., from button to link).
